operation.summary: Submit a content or user report
operation.description:
Authenticated access cookie or Bearer JWT required (cookie takes precedence); this user-facing report submission calls v2Auth only and does not require requireModerationAccess or the moderation admin allow-list.
v2CreateReport: target_id must normalize to a positive finite number. Unsupported target_type/reason/priority normalize to post/other/normal. Supports ordinary and group posts/comments plus users; checks target table existence without filtering deletion/activity status. Reporting oneself as a user is 403. Inserts pending report, creates/synchronizes target case report count/priority and returns the serialized report with nullable reporter/handler. Success is HTTP 200, not 201. No duplicate-report prevention is implemented in this handler. ensureModerationSchema may perform DDL; no runtime calls were made.
Error JSON is Nitro transport with business error envelope nested under data; Accept:text/html may return a Nuxt HTML error page. Static source audit only.

200.description: Report created and case statistics synchronized. HTTP 200; pending report status.

400.description: Body not a JSON object, invalid JSON, or missing/non-finite/non-positive target_id. Unsupported target_type/reason/priority are normalized rather than rejected.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked authenticated access session.

403.description: target_type=user and target_id equals current authenticated user. No moderation-admin gate applies.

404.description: Target does not exist in corresponding table, or inserted report cannot be reloaded.

429.description: Global Redis/IP rate limit may reject more than 100 requests in 10 seconds.

default.description: Database/schema/DDL/framework failures; no global transaction rollback guarantee. Case creation helpers can auto-commit before the final explicit commit.

requestBody.description: JSON object required; target_id mandatory, other fields use documented coercions/defaults.

AuditedModerationJsonValue.description: Any JSON value accepted by the existing input coercion/ignore paths; this is not an unspecified business response object.

AuditedModerationCoercedString.description: v2String: strings unchanged; JSON numbers/booleans converted using String(value); null, object and array values yield the caller fallback (normally empty string). The accepted JSON types here are deliberately broad because the service performs this exact coercion.

AuditedModerationPageMeta.description: v2Page does not truncate fractions; page and page_size are numbers, not guaranteed integers. total is COUNT(*); has_next is page*page_size < total.

AuditedModerationPublicUser.description: Exact v2MapPublicUser output; numeric flags remain numbers. v2DateString can preserve unparseable strings, so timestamps are not narrowed to date-time.

AuditedModerationMedia.description: Exact v2MapMedia output, including description which is missing from the older shared V2MediaAsset schema.

AuditedModerationUser.description: Exact v2ListModerationUsers mapper. is_active/is_verified are numeric database flags, not JSON booleans. status is a stored string, not an enforced API enum.

AuditedModerationStats.description: Counts across moderation tables (not the content-list filter). today_processed counts approve/reject/flag/remove/restore/ban/mute actions since database TRUNC(SYSDATE). avg_process_minutes is rounded average case duration; appeal_success_rate is rounded approved/(approved+rejected)*100; null aggregates become 0.

AuditedModerationSetting.description: value is always a string, even when value_type is number or boolean. GET returns all stored setting rows, not only the four recognized PATCH keys.

action.description: Omitted, null, object or array uses flag via v2String fallback. A supplied string must be a listed action; numbers/booleans stringify to invalid actions and produce 400.

AuditedModerationActionInput.description: JSON object required; no fields required because action defaults to flag. Unknown fields ignored. duration_hours is not read by this post action handler.

post_ids.description: v2NumberArray retains finite JSON numbers and strings convertible by Number; null, empty strings, booleans, objects, arrays and invalid numeric strings are discarded. Zero/negative values and duplicates are retained. At least one normalized id must remain or 400; each retained value is then checked for existence (404). Duplicates are processed repeatedly and counted.

action.description: Same fallback to flag as single-post action. claim/release are not accepted for bulk operations.

duration_hours.description: v2Number(value,24): finite numbers and finite numeric strings are used; other values fall back to 24 (null/boolean are not Number-coerced). No integer/positive restriction. ban <=0 means no end; mute uses max(value,1). unban/unmute/note ignore duration for restrictions but record it in the action log.

status.description: Recognized: pending, in_review, resolved, dismissed. Omitted/unknown/coerced unsupported input normalizes to pending, not 400. Only this body field is read.

appeal_status.description: Recognized approved/rejected; missing or any other value normalizes to rejected.

key.description: Only auto_hide_report_threshold, require_note_on_reject, allow_moderator_claim, default_mute_hours are updated; other keys silently ignored.

anyOf.description: Non-object entries are ignored. Array entries also have no recognized key and are ignored.
Non-array settings is treated as an empty update list.

AuditedModerationSettingsInput.description: Missing settings, empty updates or unknown keys are successful no-ops. Recognized values are stored as coerced strings without numeric/boolean validation; value_type is not updated. Response lists all stored settings.

AuditedModerationHttpError.description: Nitro 2.13.3 default JSON error transport, statically read from installed prod/dev runtime. Application v2Throw/auth errors put V2ErrorResponse inside data, not at the top level. Rate limiter uses the legacy-shaped data alternative. data may be omitted for parser/unhandled errors; stack is dev-only. Nuxt 4.4.2 requests explicitly accepting text/html can receive an HTML error page in development or production; request Accept:application/json for this transport. No runtime acceptance is asserted.

anyOf.description: Must parse using Number(value) to a finite value >0; invalid/empty values produce 400. Decimal ids are not rejected as non-integers by this helper.

target_id.description: v2RequiredNumber; required, positive and finite after normalization; string/numeric forms accepted.

target_type.description: Recognized post/comment/user/group_post/group_comment. Missing or unrecognized values normalize to post, never a target_type validation error.

reason.description: Recognized spam/harassment/hate/violence/adult/misinformation/copyright/other; missing or unsupported normalizes to other.

priority.description: Recognized low/normal/high/urgent; missing or unsupported normalizes to normal.

evidence_url.description: v2StringOrNull: coercion then an empty result becomes null. No URL format validation.

AuditedModerationCreateReportInput.description: Authenticated report submission; does not require moderation account allow-list. Unknown fields ignored. DB column lengths/constraints can still fail; no application-level string length validator is asserted.

Authenticated access cookie or Bearer JWT required (cookie takes precedence); this user-facing report submission calls v2Auth only and does not require requireModerationAccess or the moderation admin allow-list. v2CreateReport: target_id must normalize to a positive finite number. Unsupported target_type/reason/priority normalize to post/other/normal. Inserts pending report, creates/synchronizes target case report count/priority and returns the serialized report with nullable reporter/handler. Success is HTTP 200, not 201. No duplicate-report prevention is implemented in this handler. ensureModerationSchema may perform DDL; no runtime calls were made.
